title: Numeric & Optimization — Where It Stands
thesis: The most rigorously measured module in the library: P0-P7 complete, ~1,827 assertions, every parallel route gated by a measured threshold and every kernel bit-identical under threads. It leads with something NumPy has no concept of, exactness: an arbitrary-precision numeric tower with a register that tells you why a value is exact or not. It reaches LAPACK-tier decompositions and ships reverse-mode autodiff with L-BFGS. It is deliberately not a NumPy: no broadcasting, raw matmul peak below tuned BLAS, and it refuses what it cannot measure a use for.

lanes.note: Arbitrary-precision tower over std.math.big: bignum, exact rationals, money-exact decimal (0.1+0.2 is exactly 0.3), plus IsExact()/Why()/Representation()
matrix.zig + linalg.zig: SIMD/threaded matmul, LU determinant, Solve, Inverse, LeastSquares, PseudoInverse (Penrose-4 verified), rank, condition; vs NumPy
Symmetric Jacobi eigen plus general non-symmetric eigen (balancing, Hessenberg, Francis double-shift QR, Schur), Jacobi SVD, Householder QR, Cholesky, roots
Reverse-mode autodiff (compiled tape, valueAndGradient) and L-BFGS with strong-Wolfe line search; verified to 8-12 decimals; Rosenbrock in 34 iterations
SIMD + row-banded threaded matmul (16x cache reorder, up to 7x threaded), Neumaier summation (2.5x), resident reductions 19x; every route gated by calib.Gate
stzNumBuffer over numbuf.zig: an engine-owned f64 buffer with dot/scale/add/sub/mul and reductions that never marshal; no broadcasting, no n-D arrays
Engine simplex (41x after a cubic re-parse fix) with branch-and-bound MIP, stzOptimModel DSL, exact coefficient compiler, .zopt round-trip; no IPM, no QP
special.zig: erf/erfc, log-gamma and gamma, incomplete gamma and beta, Normal/t/chi-square/F CDFs and quantiles; no Bessel, Airy, elliptic or hypergeometric
solver.zig: linear and quadratic roots, bisection, Newton, Simpson integration, polynomial eval, lerp/clamp/map-range; no adaptive quadrature, no ODE/BVP
random.zig over Xoshiro/PCG/ChaCha: seeded ints, floats, Gaussian, exponential, shuffle, Bernoulli, weighted choice under SeedRandom; no binomial/Poisson/gamma
fft.zig: radix-2 Cooley-Tukey with the NumPy fft/ifft convention, convolveReal, magnitudes, phases, power spectrum; radix-2 only, no rfft, no multi-dimensional
complex.zig: arithmetic, modulus (hypot), argument, conjugate, principal sqrt and exp, division via Smith's formula; no log, inverse-trig or general powers

standouts: An exactness register (IsExact, Why, Representation) that NumPy has no concept of
General non-symmetric eigen with a Francis double-shift QR, hand-rolled and verified
Reverse-mode autodiff paired with a real quasi-Newton (L-BFGS) optimizer
Nothing parallel ships without a measurement; many gaps are deliberate, measured refusals
gaps: Arbitrary-N and multi-dimensional FFT (mixed-radix / Bluestein, rfft, 2-D)
Complete the complex surface: log, inverse-trig and general powers
Adaptive quadrature and an ODE stepper
Broaden sampling distributions (binomial, Poisson, gamma, beta, Dirichlet)
